contrasts.scope: Combined implementation, adapter and acceptance-policy changes; individual fixes require separate ablations
Different phenotype and truth experiments; cannot by itself establish an inference correction or historical ranking reversal

grouping: one existing regional design stratum at a time; reference-panel sizes are distinct regimes
contribution: Retain finite paired differences separately for each endpoint; undefined scores and absent stages remain explicit denominator counts
brier: Assess event-alignment flags on the exact contributing pairs; unqualified alignment permits an operational diagnostic only
genotype_and_truth_counts: Use retained candidate counts and audited synthetic GWAS/reference sample sizes, not nominal p as target prevalence or a published GWAS cohort claim
cluster: Whole input panel for pooled methods; frozen panel/region for other methods
uncertainty_scope: Conditional on supplied genotype design; fewer than two declared independent clusters gives a point difference without a confidence interval
historical_status: New-seed original-code reproductions; original historical per-locus results remain unavailable
publication: Require complete full-profile sealed collection; integration or partial exports must be explicitly labeled development or incomplete
